request.what: Reimburse a 100,000 ADA Info-action deposit that was unrecoverable due to a Cardano node bug, plus 3,000 ADA for lost staking rewards
request.recipient: The original Ikigai Info governance action submitter
deliverables: A one-time reimbursement payment; no ongoing deliverables

claims.claim: A node bug let an unregistered stake key be used, leaving the Ikigai submitter unable to recover a 100,000 ADA deposit
An extra 3,000 ADA is requested to compensate for lost staking rewards at roughly 2% per annum
The action meets the constitution's metadata and treasury-withdrawal formatting requirements

summary: A 103,000 ADA one-time reimbursement to an early governance pioneer whose deposit was stranded by a node bug, plus a small staking-reward top-up.
